clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal Glades, Executor Zygand waits for overdue field reports. He sends you to gather updates from Deathguards near Brill and a sentry by Stillwater Pond.

Executor Zygand commands local security in Tirisfal Glades and allows no lapse in vigilance. Serving Lady Sylvanas, he expects every duty done without fail. When scheduled field reports do not reach his post, he treats the delay as a breach of duty. He stays at his post and sends Forsaken agents to find the tardy subordinates and keep the borders secure.

Sentries at key points around Brill owe Zygand their reports. Deathguard Dillinger watches the graveyard west of town, where rogue undead and Scourge remnants stir. East of Brill, Deathguard Kristof guards a waystation on the approaches to the Capital City and the eastern roads. Gordo is the strangest sentry: a hulking abomination who wanders near Stillwater Pond, where military record-keeping seems a poor fit for his simple mind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Make no mistake, adventurer--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.
Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.
You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
